title: Statistical Measures and Displays
preview: Statistical questions, dot plots, histograms, measures of center and spread, box plots, and identifying outliers.
description: Indiana standards 6.DSP.1–3. Students formulate statistical questions, choose appropriate displays, compute measures of center and spread, and interpret what those summaries say about the data.

sections.label: 10-1 Statistical Questions
sections.description: Recognise a statistical question as one that anticipates variability; design questions and collect data.

sections.label: 10-2 Dot Plots and Histograms
sections.description: Construct and interpret dot plots and histograms.

sections.label: 10-3 Measures of Center
sections.description: Compute and interpret mean and median; choose an appropriate measure for the context.

sections.label: 10-4 Interquartile Range and Box Plots
sections.description: Compute IQR; construct and interpret box plots.

sections.label: 10-5 Outliers
sections.description: Identify outliers and discuss their effect on measures of center and spread.

sections.label: 10-6 Interpret Graphical Displays
sections.description: Describe overall patterns, striking deviations, and what the chosen measures suggest about the context.
